body: Request36b2b1ad source review complete with explicit REMAINING LIVENESS BLOCKER. Tests6877a4af+1b33e2e3, narrow productfa3a69ba, detailed reviewed contracted41ff71 pushed origin/codex/document-save-dismiss-attachment. Preserve existing3d08368e and cherry-pick narrow commits only; no trace or current-main Layers overwrite. Apple docs do not guarantee ordering between SwiftUI onDismiss and AppKit didEnd; latter names only parent/no userInfo, so cannot infer captured lifetime. Safe bounded improvement: factor exact request/captured-parent/captured-sheet attachment check and call it during logical settlement BEFORE clearing presented item as well as dismissal. This records actual attachment at Cancel/supersession so native end may precede SwiftUI dismiss without losing identity. Same native-detach/join guards, no forced end/timing/new Observable reads. Tests include Cancel-attached then end-before-dismiss, unrelated-sheet negative, and already-observed attachment control. ALL UNRUN. IMPORTANT fourth test testKnownGapEntireAttachmentAfterCancelWithoutAnyObservationNeedsProgress is deliberately expected by source inspection to FAIL final source: Cancel while unattached, entire attachment/end unseen, live probe, parent-only end cannot prove captured lifetime. Do not treat this package as all-green/merge-ready or waive that failure. It is indistinguishable from unrelated sheet ending; safe release needs extra per-generation native presentation ownership/completion evidence (proposed adapter-owned beginSheet completion joined with physical detach, not implemented). Handoff tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/DOCUMENT-SAVE-END-BEFORE-DISMISS-REVIEW.md links API contracts and limits. B no workloads; A owns gates/main. Do not claim fully unseen lifecycle fixed or observed on hardware; original e51 ordering was dismiss-before-end.
